“Duncan’s on trial,” a girl beside you whispers. “We think he told a grownup about our hiding place. That’s treason, that is!”

EN: {He(Child)} uses all {his(Child)} technical tricks to disprove Duncan’s alibi: sensors, the background noise of audio recordings, even the isotopes in his clothing.

EN: {His(Child)} attitude is rhetorical; charismatic. {He(Child)} affably examines Duncan’s lies, then discards them like so much fluff.

“Which brings us,” {Child} smiles, “to our expert witness. My {title(PlayerCharacter)}, as a judicial expert what punishment would you recommend?”

“O que nos traz”, {Child} sorri, “à nossa testemunha especial. {title(PlayerCharacter)}, como especialista da justiça, qual punição você recomendaria?”
